perspective:
**Arthur Chung’s available information:**

- Arthur knows he is Arthur Chung, a plumber with a doctorate. He knows Teresa Ortega as a medical assistant and colleague. They have worked together on community service projects; from his perspective, the relationship is professional and respectful, though they sometimes misunderstand each other.
- **Scenario 1:** Arthur notices Teresa working hard and appearing overwhelmed. He offers help. Teresa says it is kind but she thinks she can manage and there is a lot to do. Arthur tells her self-care matters and offers to help. Teresa accepts help organizing medical supplies. Arthur starts helping.
- **Scenario 2:** Arthur believes Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability. He feels empathetic. He tells her accepting help does not mean she is not capable. Teresa says she wants to show she can do it herself. Arthur says teamwork can be more effective and it is not about proving anything. Teresa agrees she needs to remind herself of that. Arthur says he is there to support her.
- **Scenario 3:** Arthur believes Teresa is still struggling. He feels frustrated that his help is not yielding results and wants to support her without making her feel inadequate. He tells her she is doing a great job and he does not want her to feel otherwise. Teresa says it has been busy and she feels behind. Arthur suggests working together on tasks instead. Teresa agrees. Arthur commits to tackling things as a team.
- **Scenario 4:** Arthur believes working together will ease Teresa’s burden and improve efficiency. He feels hopeful. Teresa says it feels less overwhelming working together. Arthur suggests he handle inventory while she manages patient records, with regular check-ins. Teresa agrees and says she is glad. Arthur agrees.
- **Scenario 5:** Arthur believes their collaboration has strengthened their professional relationship. He feels satisfied. Teresa says it has been a great experience and their teamwork paid off. Arthur suggests continuing the collaborative approach in future projects. Teresa says that is a fantastic idea and they are more efficient/effective as a team. Arthur says he looks forward to their next project. Teresa thanks him for being supportive.
